notes.title: Playtest is live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

The playtest is now live! During the playtest all the participants will earn [b]exclusive rewards[/b] and based on your feedback you will help shape the future of [b]Cactiverse[/b]! Join our Discord for more info and frequent updates and announcements. Thank you all for joining and wishing you all the best of luck and have fun.

MythrilCodeLabs team
